ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, a quadrilateral is inscribed in $\odot O$. If one of its exterior angles $\angle DCE=46^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in circle $\odot O$,\\
it follows that $\angle A+\angle BCD=180^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle DCE+\angle BCD=180^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle A=\angle DCE=46^\circ$,\\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{46^\circ}$.
